punchline: One test was listed at 95 percent; the engineer who ran it measured 65.
thirty_sec: In 2013 Tyler Shultz started validating Theranos's Edison syphilis test. It caught about 65 percent of known positive samples, and a report said 95. He emailed Elizabeth Holmes, and the answer came from her president, who objected to his tone. Tyler left, lawyers pursued him, and Carreyrou's first article ran in October 2015.
